name: academic-ref-inserter
title_zh: docx 里引文乱序、缺超链接时，它按 GB/T 7
tagline_zh: 改稿到一半发现参考文献编号全乱了？它自动重排引文顺序、补交叉引用超链接，还能一键切换中英文标准，不用手动数序号。
tagline_en: Mid-edit and your reference numbers are a mess? It renumbers citations in order, adds cross-ref hyperlinks, and.
desc_en: Inserts, formats, and cross-references academic citations in docx. Invoke when user needs to insert references, fix citation order, add cross-reference hyperlinks, or reformat bibliography to Chinese (GB/T 7714) or international (IEEE/APA) standards.
why_zh: 它读的是 docx 内部的引用关系，不是表面文字，所以能真正重排编号并同步正文，而不是只改个格式。
why_en: It parses the docx's internal reference relationships, not just visible text, so it can truly renumber and sync in-text.
limit_zh: 只处理 docx 文件，且要求文档内已有可识别的引文标记；纯文本或 PDF 需先转换。不负责检索文献元数据。
limit_en: Only works on .docx with existing citation markers; plain text/PDF need conversion. It won't fetch metadata—you must supply full reference entries.
title_en: Reorder & cross-link citations in docx to GB/T 7714 or.
